findings.summary: OPEN ATTRIBUTION RESOLVED for CF-2026-08-26-20: council #12 (run 32881828740) was NOT cancelled by any hidden actor or manual intervention — it was superseded by THIS run's creation. Push 37f9575 touched cto-council.yml at 18:37:51Z, GitHub created #13 at 18:37:53Z into the single-slot group, and #12's cancel stamp followed at 18:37:55Z (2s). The 'hidden occupant' hypothesis for #12's slot is thereby weakened: the slot was freed exactly when #13 arrived, matching newest-pending-wins semantics already adjudicated for councils #6/#7/#10/#11.

Self-trigger waste mechanism struck again with double intensity: within 5m13s TWO council-self edits (37f9575 at 18:37:51Z, c97680b at 18:43:04Z) each produced one wasted council dispatch — 37f9575's own firing died queued here, and its arrival killed the previous mitigation-commit firing (#12). Chain now fully attributed across three consecutive deaths: b2d747e -> #11 died queued; b4dbd709 -> #12 died queued (killed by #13's creation); 37f9575 -> #13 died queued (killed by c97680b successor). Any workflow listing itself in push paths burns one dispatch per fix commit during iteration bursts.

The feed-gated council wake ('wake only on actionable run-evidence feed', b4dbd709) has still NEVER executed successfully as of this run's death (18:43:07Z Aug 25) — every firing since gating landed died queued.
